_comment: Default rules for SADs built on the ASPICE SAD template (AU-QR-R&D-032 family), whether exported from CodeBeamer (docx, one ID table per item) or written by sad-generator (md). Rules match on bilingual heading TITLES (numbering stripped), never on chapter numbers. A project overrides any key via swit_project.json -> sad.profile_overrides; extra anchors go to sad.extra_anchors.

item_detection._comment: id_table: an item is a heading followed by a 2-column table whose first cell matches id_label_regex (CodeBeamer export). heading: IDs are searched in the heading text with id_regex. auto: id_table if any such table exists, else heading.

interface.api_table_header_regex: (?i)^(syntax|prototype|signature|原型|签名|原型/签名|函数原型)$

anchors.title_regex: (?i)^(软件运行模式\s*)?software operating modes?$|^软件运行模式$
(?i)^(软件功能模式\s*)?software functional modes?$|^软件功能模式$
(?i)^(共享资源保护\s*)?shared resources? protection|^共享资源保护
(?i)^(时基识别\s*)?timing bases identification|^时基识别

transition_table._comment: State-transition tables: columns located by header text; label_regex handles '[TRANS_A_TO_B] | condition' tables.
transition_table.from_regex: (?i)^(from|source|start|current|起始|源状态|当前状态|起始状态)
transition_table.to_regex: (?i)^(to|target|next|destination|跳转|目标状态|下一状态|跳转状态)
